title: Run reads teach field selection and continuation
current: CLI list returns byte-bounded summary rows with next_cursor and a detail recipe. Multi-field get selects only named columns; single-field get returns its scalar. Shipping overview remains an explicit rich read. Older serving contracts refuse with the required read capability and individual-field recovery.
verification: Source tests cover exact field selection, default JSON and human output bytes, Unicode byte paging, stable equal-timestamp continuation, restricted visibility and older-server refusal.
